subject: Next steps: 30-min product intro + who should join
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@hollowai.com>, Chris Tang <ctang@hollowai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: 30-min product intro + who should join

Hi Alicia / Chris —

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to hear about HollowAI's ingestion pipeline and the latency/cost sensitivity around your annotator workflows. As a quick recap:
- Primary use case: short-form summarization + embedding index for search, heavy tail on sequence length (~1.2k tokens).
- Key constraints: sub-150ms per-token tail latency target for interactive annotator UI; strict audit logs and SSO (SAML) required for initial pilot.

To keep momentum, we'd like to lock a 30-minute product intro/demo next week. Please pick one slot that works best for your team (times are in PT):
1) Tue, Jun 1 — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Wed, Jun 2 — 13:00–13:30 PT
3) Thu, Jun 3 — 16:00–16:30 PT

Ask: can you confirm the primary attendees for the session (product/engineering/security) so we make sure the right Redwood folks join? If Chris wants a deeper security discussion, we can schedule a follow-up 60-min technical review.

I've attached a very short pre-demo checklist and a couple of questions that help us tailor the run-through. If you have any calendar constraints, tell me which slot to reserve and I’ll send the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: pre-demo-questions.pdf (1 page), pre-demo-checklist.pdf (1 page)
